verdict.rationale: Highnote documents adjacent risk-management tooling — spend rules/velocity controls, real-time collaborative authorization for approve/decline logic, webhook notifications for monitoring events, and an in-house disputes/chargeback team — but none of the evidence explicitly mentions network fraud scores, Highnote's own fraud models surfaced at auth time, suspicious-activity alerts, or dedicated block-and-reissue tooling for compromised cards. missing for 10: explicit fraud-score/fraud-model surfacing at authorization, named suspicious-activity alerting, and documented card-block/reissue workflow for fraud compromise.
